pie: kúdʰe toy pótis h₁ésti? pótis moy h₁éḱwons déwkti. wékʷsperoy h₁ludʰḗti. h₁ím lubʰyési? h₁ím lubʰyóh₂. h₁éy h₁wésus wiHrós.
english: Where is your husband? My husband is leading the horses. He will arrive in the evening. Do you love him? I love him. He is a good man.

pie: wéwke moy kʷís toy démi tḱéyti? ph₂tḗr moy méh₂tēr-kʷe h₁idʰé tḱités. dwóh₁ moy bʰréh₂terh₁e swésōr-kʷe h₁idʰé tḱiyénti. pótnih₂ toy h₂én h₁ésti? h₂én h₁ésti h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁-kʷe wr̥ǵyéti.
english: Tell me: who lives in your house? My father and my mother live here. Two brothers of mine and a sister live here. Is your wife there? She is there, and she is working with the wool.

pie: bʰréh₂teres toy démi h₁sénti? démi ne h₁sénti. dwóh₁ moy bʰréh₂terh₁e gʷéwbʰis ḱóm h₁stés. wékʷsperoy nésōntor. swésōr-kʷe toy? h₁idʰé sédyeti.
english: Are your brothers at home? They are not at home. My two brothers are with the cattle. In the evening they will return home. And your sister? She is sitting here.

pie: h₁yód pékʷes tód swéh₂dt. h₂éḱh₃s nu-kʷe tetórpth₂e. h₁uséwōm te déh₃tor gʷr̥néHmi. gʷḗn n̥sméy priHéh₂ h₁sdʰí h₂ew-kʷe gʷm̥dʰí.
english: What you cooked has become tasty. You have eaten, and now you are satisfied. I praise you, giver of good things. Be dear to us, woman, and come again!

pie: kʷésyo démi tḱéysi? swéḱurosyo moy démi tḱéymi. h₁ésyo moy suHnóws pótis. dayh₂wḗr toy h₂yéwHō? h₁éy h₂yéwHō. gʷéwbʰos h₂usési séngʷʰeti.
english: In whose house do you live? I live in the house of my father-in-law. His son is my husband. Is your husband's brother young? He is young. At dawn he sings to the cows.

pie: awis akwabʰyams ā wawakat: kard agʰnutai mai widanti manum akwams agantam.
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: h₁regʷesyéti. h₁regʷesyéti. ḱéywe príHe h₁n̥dóm gʷm̥sḱé. wĺ̥kʷōs ḱóymons gʷm̥sḱónti. ḱwónes toy nos h₂léksōnti? h₂léksōnti nos.
english: It is getting dark. It is getting dark. Come inside, dear friend! The wolves are coming to the villages. Will your dogs guard us? They will guard us.

pie: kʷíd toy méh₂tēr h₂usési dʰédʰeh₁ti? gʷṓs h₂usési h₂mélǵti. nu h₂Hséh₂i pékʷeti. kʷíd-kʷe toy ph₂tḗr dʰédʰeh₁ti? gʷṓs h₂éǵrom h₂éǵeti.
english: What does your mother do at dawn? At dawn she milks the cows. Then she cooks at the hearth. And what does your father do? He drives the cattle to the pasture.

pie: kʷíd toy méh₂tēr dʰédʰeh₁ti? h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m tn̥néwti. swóns suHnúns h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁ woséyesi. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ néweh₂? h₁íh₂ néweh₂. h₂óweyes nos h₁íh₂m̥ dh₃ént.
english: What is your mother doing? She is stretching the wool. With the wool she clothes her sons. Is it new wool? It is new. Our sheep gave it.

pie: kʷíd wékʷsperoy dʰedʰh₁té? wékʷsperoy h₂éydʰoy sédyomes. h₂éwh₂os moy séneh₂ wékʷesh₂ h₂roh₁dʰéyeti. kʷíd gʷéHyonti? méǵh₂ deywṓm ḱléwos gʷéHyeti.
english: What do you do in the evening? In the evening we sit at the fire. My grandfather speaks old words. What does he sing? He sings the great fame of the gods.

pie: pl̥h₁h₂é. príHe h₁ddʰí. pótnih₂n̥s moy toy ḱód h₂réydʰet. tetórph₂e. nu píph₃e. nu légʰesi.
english: I have become full. Eat, friend! My wife prepared this for you. I am satisfied. Then drink! Then you will lie down.

pie: gʷṓs h₂mélǵsi? h₁íns moḱs h₂mélǵmi. swésōr moy h₂ówins h₂mélǵti. h₁íd ne h₁éwkm̥. moḱs gʷm̥dʰí déyḱōh₂-kʷe toy.
english: Do you milk the cows? I milk them early. My sister milks the sheep. I have not learned it. Come early, and I shall show you!

pie: nu dṓm h₁éymi. príHe moy kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. deywṓs te ph₂sih₁ént. dṓm-kʷe toy ph₂sih₁ént. h₂ew gʷm̥dʰí.
english: I am going home now. Be well, my friend! May the gods guard you! And may they guard your house! Come again!

pie: kʷíd h₁n̥gʷnéyey wékʷsperoy mléwHsi? ḱód mléwHmi. h₁ń̥gʷney nos dṓm nókʷtm̥ pér ph₂sdʰí. suHnúns nos mē h₁éwses. h₁n̥gʷnís te ḱléwseti? ḱléwseti nos. h₁n̥gʷnís deywós.
english: What do you say to the fire in the evening? I say this. Fire, guard our house through the night! Do not burn our sons! Does the fire listen to you? He listens to us. The fire is a god.

pie: bʰh₂dʰí moy kʷíd h₂usési dʰédʰeh₁si? h₂usési bʰéwdʰoh₂. h₂ówins h₂éǵrom déwkmi. kʷóm-kʷe bʰéwdʰesi? h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ léwkt bʰéwdʰoh₂. príHe Héh₂m̥ni swopéyesi.
english: Speak to me: what do you do at dawn? At dawn I am awake. I lead the sheep to the pasture. And when are you awake? When the sun has become bright, I am awake. You sleep in the daylight, friend!

pie: kʷís h₂éHsh₂? h₂éHsh₂ ph₂wéns sédos. gʷénh₂es h₂én wr̥ǵyónti. h₂éHsh₂ moy démi ne h₁ésti. kʷértroh₁ pékʷoh₂. péh₂wr̥ kʷértroy h₁ésti? péh₂wr̥ h₁ésmi ne h₁ésti. nu kʷíh₁ gʷʰr̥néwti?
english: What is a hearth? The hearth is the seat of the fire. There the women work. In my house there is no hearth. I cook with a machine. Is there fire in the machine? There is no fire in it. Then how does it heat?

pie: kʷís gʰóstis? gʰóstis h₂nḗr h₁yós nos dʰwórm̥ gʷm̥yéti. h₁ésmey sédos wódr̥-kʷe dedh₃més. h₁ím-kʷe kʷsépi h₂léksomes. h₁eǵóh₂ gʰóstis? túH gʰóstis túH-kʷe n̥sméy ḱéywos.
english: What is a guest? A guest is a man who comes to our door. We give him a seat and water. And we protect him in the night. Am I a guest? You are a guest, and you are dear to us.

pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód wérh₁oh₂? kʷíd toy h₁nómn̥? kʷíd toy h₁nómn̥? h₂n̥réy toy ḱód dʰwóri préḱsdʰi. kʷíd-kʷe wérh₁eti? swóm h₁nómn̥ wérh₁eti.
english: How do I say this? What is your name? What is your name? Ask this of a man at your door. And what will he say? He will say his own name.

pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód sékʷoh₂? tr̥syóh₂. tr̥syóh₂. tr̥syési? tr̥syóh₂. nu ḱód wódr̥ ph₃dʰí.
english: How do I say this? I am thirsty. I am thirsty. Are you thirsty? I am thirsty. Then drink this water!

pie: léwktrom moy kʷsépi léwkt. péh₂wr̥ kʷsépi spéḱyomes. stégos gʷʰr̥néwti. stégos ne h₁éwseti? stégos ne h₁éwseti méh₂tēr-kʷe moy péh₂wr̥ péh₂sti.
english: At night my lamp becomes bright. At night we watch the fire. It heats the house. Does it not burn the house? It does not burn the house, and my mother guards the fire.

pie: tód ḱeḱluwṓs h₂ówis h₂éǵrom ebʰuge(t).
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: suHnús toy stéygʰeti? ne stéygʰeti. dʰwóri sérpeti ḱwṓ-kʷe h₁ím léyǵʰti. h₂uksyéh₁t. deywṓs tód dh₃ih₁ént.
english: Is your son walking? He is not walking. He crawls by the door, and the dog licks him. May he grow up! May the gods give that!

pie: príHe moy gʷéHye. ḱéywe ssdʰí ssdʰí. méh₂tēr toy twé spéḱyeti. h₂éydʰos dʰégʷʰeti h₂óweyes-kʷe légʰyonti. tód h₁wésu.
english: Sing to me, friend! Sleep, dear one, sleep! Your mother is watching you. The fire burns, and the sheep are lying down. That is good.

pie: kʷíd swépnoy widés? h₂éwh₂om moy swépnoy widóm. lelóykʷe swépnoy-kʷe smḗyt. wr̥h₁tóm toy? wérh₁t moy swā́s swésorn̥s h₂lékse.
english: What did you see in your sleep? In my sleep I saw my grandfather. He is gone, and in my sleep he was laughing. Did he speak to you? He spoke to me: "Guard your own sisters!"

pie: kʷís toy méh₂tr̥s méh₂tēr? h₁íh₂ h₁suménēs. h₁íh₂ moy lewbʰéh₂. h₂yuHn̥ḱóybʰos nékʷti séngʷʰeti. kʷíd séngʷʰeti? h₂éwsosm̥ diwés dʰugh₂térm̥ séngʷʰeti.
english: Who is your mother's mother? She is Kindly. She is dear to me. At night she sings to the young ones. What does she sing? She sings of Dawn, daughter of Sky.

pie: ḱósmi kʷid dinóy ne h₂éḱh₃m̥. príHe sddʰí. pótnih₂ moy pékʷeti. stégesi nos h₁ddʰí. túH moy h₁wésus.
english: I have eaten nothing on this day. Sit down, friend! My wife is cooking. Eat in our house! You are good to me.

pie: kʷís snusós? snusós suHnóws pótnih₂. suHnóws moy nos pótnih₂ démi tḱéyti. h₁íh₂ toy lewbʰéh₂? h₁íh₂ moy lewbʰéh₂ pótnih₂-kʷe moy h₁íh₂m̥ stérgeti.
english: What is a daughter-in-law? A daughter-in-law is the wife of a son. My son's wife dwells in our house. Is she dear to you? She is dear to me, and my wife cherishes her.

pie: owis eḱwoi kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses
